start: Member, first own workout finished, a Wear OS watch connected without MettleUp

user_sees: Card 'MettleUp works on your watch too'
'See your rest timer and next set on your wrist.'
must_not: The card before the member's own first workout
The card during the welcome demo

user_sees: Then 'Check your watch: its Play Store is open on MettleUp. Tap Install there.'
must_not: A second open on a fast second tap
The card closing before the member reads the line
The card back on the next visit

start: Member, welcome demo with sample workouts loaded, Wear OS watch without MettleUp

must_not: The card shown on sample workouts
A question sent to Wear OS before an own workout is saved

start: Member, first workout done, the watch went out of reach after the card showed

user_sees: 'Your watch is not connected. Open Play Store on your watch and search MettleUp.'
must_not: A success line when nothing opened on the watch
A crash or endless 'Opening on your watch…'

start: Member, phone with no watch paired

steps.action: Finish a workout, open the Workout tab
must_not: A card about a watch the member does not have
The card shown again on a later visit
Another notice slot left empty in its place

steps.action: Install MettleUp on the watch by hand, open the Workout tab
must_not: The card asking to install an app that is already there

user_sees: Only the watch's own Play Store opens
must_not: Workout data sent to the watch or to MettleUp by the install check
